transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?

I've been struggling with persistent, unwanted thoughts lately that cause me a lot of anxiety. I also feel this overwhelming urge to perform certain repetitive actions or rituals just to make those thoughts go away. It's starting to really take over my daily life.

latest_inference.note: The patient endorses persistent unwanted thoughts (obsessions) and repetitive behaviors or mental acts (compulsions) performed to reduce anxiety, which are hallmark symptoms of Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder. No other conditions from the allowed list better account for this symptom pattern at this time.
